text: On the cosmos_qa testbed we evaluated a weak-to-strong training method that reweights weak labels by the frozen strong model's margin, using a margin temperature of 1.0. Across 16 seeds, the method attains a performance gap recovered (PGR) of 0.57 with a standard error of 0.05. This indicates that, under this configuration, the strong student recovers a little over half of the gap between the weak supervisor and the strong ceiling, and the seed-to-seed spread is moderate rather than large. An important caveat is that no baseline PGR was provided in this experiment, so the number cannot be read as an improvement over naive weak-label finetuning or over any other reweighting scheme; it stands only as a standalone measurement. Similarly, only a single margin temperature was tested, so nothing here speaks to the sensitivity of the method to that hyperparameter. A comparison run with a matched baseline and a temperature sweep would be needed to interpret the result.
